written_solution: Move the gray(5) marker to the selected endpoint of the nearest straight background/zero boundary run
program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  ;; Position of the first gray(5) cell
  (define marker (fst (find-color g 5)))
  (define mr (fst marker))
  (define mc (snd marker))
  (define (md p) (+ (abs (- (fst p) mr)) (abs (- (snd p) mc))))
  (define (bnd? r c)
    (and (in-bounds? r c h w)
         (= (at g r c) 7)
         (for/or ((d cardinal-deltas))
           (let ((nr (+ r (fst d))) (nc (+ c (snd d))))
             (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) 0))))))
  (define (run-from r c dr dc)
    (let loop ((rr r) (cc c) (acc (list)))
      (if (bnd? rr cc)
        (loop (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc) (append acc (list (list rr cc))))
        acc)))
  (define dirs (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1) (list 1 -1)))
  (define infos
    (apply append
      (map (lambda (d)
        (filter (lambda (info) (and (not (empty? info)) (>= (length (fst info)) 2)))
          (map (lambda (p)
            (let* ((r (fst p)) (c (snd p)) (dr (fst d)) (dc (snd d))
                   (pr (- r dr)) (pc (- c dc)))
              (if (and (bnd? r c) (not (bnd? pr pc)))
                (list (run-from r c dr dc) dr dc)
                (list))))
            (grid-positions g))))
        dirs)))
  (if (empty? infos) g
    (let* ((best (fst (sort infos (lambda (a b)
             (let ((da (min-list (map md (fst a)))) (db (min-list (map md (fst b)))))
               (if (= da db)
                 (> (length (fst a)) (length (fst b)))
                 (< da db)))))))
           (run (fst best))
           (dr (snd best))
           (dc (nth best 2))
           (ends (list (fst run) (nth run (- (length run) 1))))
           (dest (fst (sort ends (lambda (a b)
             (if (and (not (= dr 0)) (not (= dc 0)))
               (> (md a) (md b))
               (< (md a) (md b))))))))
      (set-cell (set-cell g mr mc 7) (fst dest) (snd dest) 5)))))
